A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 24-page versions of the same v-HUB paper. Their text, tables, figures and Appendices A–E are available for reliable comparison, including the image-based annotation materials.

before.justification: v2 reports original evaluations of MLLMs on v-HUB, including task performance in Section 4 and human evaluation and supplementary results in Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark evaluations, human ratings and supplementary empirical results reported in v2.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction, annotation and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Table 16 rewraps the same QA-generation prompt without changing its wording or procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 1,218 videos, comprising 267 Chaplin clips and 951 user-generated videos, for caption matching, humor explanation and open-ended QA. The modality scenarios and evaluated subsets are unchanged.

E2.justification: The seven MLLMs listed in Table 7 retain the same participation in the reported comparisons. Tables 6 and 11 also retain the same Qwen2.5-72B and Qwen2.5-7B base-LLM comparisons.

E3.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendix B retain the same input settings, metrics, caption distractor construction and human-evaluation protocol, including 50 sampled explanations rated by one annotator. No evaluation setting or procedure is revised.

E4.justification: The visual-text, background-knowledge, video-era and base-LLM analyses in Section 4.3 and Appendix C are unchanged. Figure 9 retains the same three case studies.

E5.justification: Annotation-consensus reporting using Krippendorff’s alpha in Section 2.4 is unchanged. Neither version adds or revises repeated-run information, seeds, confidence intervals or statistical testing procedures.

E6.justification: Numerical results in Tables 2–6 and 8–15 and qualitative findings in Figure 9 are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains Qwen2.5-VL caption-matching accuracy of 0.726 for Text-Only and 0.666 for Video-Only.

T1.justification: Task definitions and the AutoDQ precision, recall and F1 descriptions in Appendix B.2 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same benchmark contributions and claims about MLLMs’ dependence on linguistic cues, difficulty understanding visual humor and benefits from environmental sound.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning modality integration, background knowledge and historical context are unchanged. Both versions retain the same limitations concerning region-level cultural categorization and English-only annotations.

D1.justification: Appendices A, B and E retain the same annotation instructions, metric package versions, model sizes and prompt content. Table 27 already exists in v2; correcting the reference to it adds no technical information.

R1.justification: The cited works, benchmark comparisons in Table 1 and research positioning in Section 5 are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgement introduces no related work or novelty claim.

P1.justification: v3 adds an acknowledgement of Zilong Zheng’s NSFC support under grant 62376031 and corrects Appendix E’s table range from Tables 16–26 to Tables 16–27. The version/date stamp changes, while scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 16 is slightly narrowed and its text rewrapped. The expanded acknowledgement reflows page 10, moving the 'Use of LLMs' lead-in to the second column. Figures and result-table displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds a funding credit, corrects a reference to an existing prompt table and makes localized layout adjustments. These small editorial refinements leave the scientific evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility information unchanged, producing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
